name: Rain
description: Rain falls over an area: plants and crops grow, fires go out.

name: Lightning
description: A bolt from the sky. Sets trees ablaze, and can hurt or kill anyone standing too close.

name: Food
description: Berry bushes spring up from the ground.

name: Bless
description: Restores one person fully and doubles how fast they learn for a few days.

name: Inspire
description: A dream that makes one person far likelier to discover something new for a while.
